note: Deploys infra/main.bicep (APIM Basic v2 is billed per hour while it exists: deploy right before, tear down right after). Subscription keys go straight into environment variables and are never printed. Record 'metrics' last (custom metrics lag by minutes).
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-02 -l swedencentral -o none
$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-2 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
$env:APIM_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY = $env:SALES_KEY; python -m aoai_gateway.smoke --requests 1 | Out-Null   # warm-up: must print one 200

screens.name: deployed
steps: Show the API Management service (Basic v2), the two Azure OpenAI accounts with their two regions in the Location column, Application Insights and the Log Analytics workspace
Optional B-roll: APIM > Backends > aoai-pool (members with priority 1 and 2) and the circuit-breaker rule on aoai-primary
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: burst
mask: the key is only in an environment variable and is never printed

screens.name: metrics
steps: Open the Application Insights resource in rg-mglab-ai-02 > Metrics
Apply splitting by 'Subscription ID'; time range last 30 minutes
Both hr-bot and sales-copilot visible (if the chart is empty wait a few minutes and refresh)
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu
never open Show/hide keys on the APIM Subscriptions page

teardown: $accts = az cognitiveservices account list -g rg-mglab-ai-02 --query "[].{n:name,l:location}" -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
foreach ($a in $accts) { az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-02 -n $a.n -l $a.l }
